This task will examine existing molecular biology and metagenomics data, as well as produce new ones as applicable.Phenotypic predictions from metagenomic datasets and using suitable training datasets from public repositories.WP2: Transport mechanism in Icy Worlds, modelling transport of contamination with focus on Enceladus. This work package will consider:Estimated depth ranges (spread)Most likely depth (average)Estimated transport time from surface to subsurface waterWP3: Reliability of spacecraft, using engineering/mission parameters, environmental specification for the mission.Integration of data:WP4: Use the data to put together a probabilistic model aided by Bayesian statistics.
